main_measure.name: mean 5-bar forward return, forecast >= 2 minus all other grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: difference > 0 with Welch t >= 2 and >= 30 cases with forecast >= 2; reject: difference < 0 with Welch t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of 5-bar forward return on forecast, grid bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: The difference is positive with Welch t >= 2 from at least 30 cases with forecast >= 2, and the supporting slope is positive.
reading: Situation taken as bars where the raw component is positive (and the day's in-window close-to-close return is up when computable), side long; grid is positions 0,5,10,... of each BTC and ETH window with grid bars lacking a 5-bar forward return in the window dropped, 'all other grid bars' means grid bars with forecast < 2, and the slope is undefined (not positive) with fewer than 2 positive-forecast cases.
